meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把一张 DAG 定义存成库里的 <name>.json,之后用名字直接重跑,不必每次粘贴定义;加载时会把 key 轮换成带时间戳的新 key,并填充 {{key}}、{{date}} 等占位符。
howto.when: 当你想保存当前的 DAG、运行已存的定义,或反复调度同一张多智能体图时触发;若要全新编写一张图,原文建议先看 mass-ulw。

say.text: 把当前这张图存成 nightly-audit,再跑一次确认
say.note: 写入库目录后立即 lib.start 验证

say.text: 跑 nightly-audit,suffix 传空字符串,复用上次结果
say.note: 完全幂等,不产生新运行

howto.what_en: Saves a DAG definition as <name>.json in a library dir and re-runs it by name, so you don't paste the definition each time. On load it rotates the key and fills {{key}}, {{date}}, {{datetime}} placeholders.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly. For authoring a brand-new graph, read mass-ulw first.

say_en.text: Save the current graph as nightly-audit and run it once to confirm
say_en.note: Writes to the library dir, then calls lib.start

say_en.text: Run nightly-audit with suffix 20260818 to reuse the same run
say_en.note: A failed node is retried on that run id

say_en.text: Run nightly-audit with an empty suffix to reuse the last result
